scope: Run@1.outcome and Run@1.breaker_tripped only (Lucas: two fields)

vectors.name: doc_run_outcome_breaker
vectors.note: terminal limit_hit Run@1, outcome route_breaker_tripped, breaker tripped

vectors.name: doc_run_outcome_breaker_not_tripped
vectors.note: canonical form is fine; the Run@1 is refused (#1100 A3 note: route_breaker_tripped needs breaker_tripped true)

vectors.name: doc_run_outcome_duplicate
vectors.note: a later outcome cannot overwrite an earlier one: refused, never last-wins

vectors.name: run_pending_null_outcome
vectors.note: pending: outcome null, breaker untripped

vectors.name: run_running_null_outcome
vectors.note: running: outcome null, breaker untripped

vectors.name: run_running_breaker_tripped
vectors.note: running with the breaker tripped: outcome stays null (the breaker is a snapshot, not an outcome)

vectors.name: run_stopping_null_outcome
vectors.note: stopping: outcome null until the stop is confirmed

vectors.name: run_running_outcome_set
vectors.note: running with an outcome: refused, outcome is null exactly while not terminal

vectors.name: run_running_breaker_outcome_early
vectors.note: running with outcome route_breaker_tripped: refused even with the breaker tripped

vectors.name: run_completed_succeeded
vectors.note: completed is the only state that is succeeded

vectors.name: run_completed_succeeded_breaker_tripped
vectors.note: breaker_tripped true does not force the outcome

vectors.name: run_failed_failed
vectors.note: failed: outcome failed

vectors.name: run_failed_unknown_breaker_tripped
vectors.note: failed: unknown allowed; breaker true does not make it route_breaker_tripped

vectors.name: run_timed_out
vectors.note: own timeout: only timed_out (F2: never a fault or breaker trip)

vectors.name: run_timed_out_as_breaker
vectors.note: own timeout claiming the breaker: refused

vectors.name: run_cancelled
vectors.note: caller stop: cancelled

vectors.name: run_stopped_kill_switch
vectors.note: core stop: stopped

vectors.name: run_stopped_breaker
vectors.note: core stop for the breaker: route_breaker_tripped with breaker_tripped true

vectors.name: run_stopped_breaker_not_tripped
vectors.note: breaker stop reporting the breaker untripped: refused (A3 note)

vectors.name: run_stopped_breaker_as_stopped
vectors.note: breaker stop must say route_breaker_tripped, not stopped

vectors.name: run_stopped_kill_switch_as_breaker
vectors.note: kill switch stop cannot claim the breaker ended it

vectors.name: run_stopped_orphan_sweep
vectors.note: orphan sweep: unknown (never success)

vectors.name: run_stopped_reason_absent
vectors.note: stopped with no stop.reason: the outcome cannot be shown to follow it, refused

vectors.name: run_stopped_reason_unknown
vectors.note: stopped with a reason outside the Stop enum: refused, never treated as consistent

vectors.name: run_stopped_reason_null
vectors.note: stopped with stop.reason null: refused

vectors.name: run_stopped_reason_caller_stop
vectors.note: caller_stop is a caller reason (that run is cancelled); a stopped run needs a core reason

vectors.name: run_stopped_stop_null
vectors.note: stopped with stop null: refused

vectors.name: run_stopped_reason_unknown_as_breaker
vectors.note: an unknown reason cannot carry a breaker outcome either

vectors.name: run_limit_hit_breaker_tripped
vectors.note: typed plan limit: route_breaker_tripped, breaker tripped

vectors.name: run_refused
vectors.note: refused: outcome refused

vectors.name: run_completed_unknown
vectors.note: unknown never pretends success

vectors.name: run_completed_null_outcome
vectors.note: terminal with null outcome: refused

vectors.name: run_outcome_absent
vectors.note: outcome is required even while null

vectors.name: run_breaker_tripped_absent
vectors.note: breaker_tripped is required

vectors.name: run_both_fields_absent
vectors.note: both fields absent

vectors.name: run_breaker_tripped_null
vectors.note: null is not a boolean

vectors.name: run_breaker_tripped_int
vectors.note: 1 is not true: canonical text keeps 1 and true distinct

vectors.name: run_breaker_tripped_string
vectors.note: a string is not a boolean

vectors.name: run_outcome_not_in_enum
vectors.note: closed enum, case-sensitive

vectors.name: run_outcome_state_name
vectors.note: a state name is not an outcome

vectors.name: run_state_wrong_case
vectors.note: state enum is case-sensitive: Completed with succeeded is refused, not consistent

vectors.name: run_state_null
vectors.note: null state with outcome succeeded: refused

vectors.name: run_state_int_breaker
vectors.note: integer state with route_breaker_tripped and the breaker tripped: refused

vectors.name: run_state_array
vectors.note: array state: refused, never a crash

vectors.name: run_state_null_outcome_null
vectors.note: null state with null outcome: refused even though the outcome is null

vectors.name: run_state_absent
vectors.note: absent state with outcome succeeded: refused

vectors.name: doc_run_outcome_breaker_reordered
vectors.note: same Run@1 as doc_run_outcome_breaker with keys reversed and whitespace: same digest

vectors.name: doc_run_outcome_escaped_key
vectors.note: escapes in the key and value unescape to the same Run@1: same digest as doc_run_outcome_breaker

vectors.name: dup_breaker_tripped
vectors.note: duplicate breaker_tripped: refused, never last-wins (false then true would otherwise pass A3)

vectors.name: dup_outcome_via_escape
vectors.note: duplicate outcome compared after unescaping

vectors.name: dup_outcome_nested_termination
vectors.note: duplicate inside the enclosing Run@1's termination: the whole document is refused

vectors.name: breaker_tripped_nan
vectors.note: NaN is refused

vectors.name: breaker_tripped_infinity
vectors.note: Infinity is refused

vectors.name: outcome_negative_infinity
vectors.note: -Infinity is refused

vectors.name: breaker_tripped_float_one
vectors.note: an integral float is still a float

vectors.name: state_seq_exponent
vectors.note: exponent form refused even when integral

vectors.name: state_seq_past_2_53
vectors.note: past 2^53-1: refused, never rounded

vectors.name: outcome_lone_surrogate
vectors.note: a lone surrogate is not a Unicode scalar value

vectors.name: outcome_bare_true
vectors.note: Python-style True is not JSON

vectors.name: run_bom
vectors.note: a byte order mark is refused
